name: Transformer tap-changer oil-level alarm
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Separates the tap-changer oil-system level indication from the transformer main-tank indication.
description: Separates the tap-changer oil-system level indication from the transformer main-tank indication. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Tap-changer level contact” at the input and “Tap-changer level alarm” at the output. Oil compartments may have separate sensors.
